name: motif-kit-sdk
description: Build, validate, migrate, bench, preview and pack Motif kits (motif-kit@4; reads motif-kit@1, @2 and @3). SDK 4.0 adds vector graphics (SDF shapes, svg inputs, text distance fields), layer stacks, speed/direction playheads and the motif-seq sequencer; SDK 3.0 added text inputs; SDK 2.0 added effects, transitions, pass graphs, export presets, capabilities and the shader sandbox.
